deviations: The packet's regression-test section mandates #[allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used)] on the test module, but anchor A3 requires grep -c 'clippy::unwrap_used' vendor/truck/truck-geometry/src/span.rs == 1 (the H-1 deny header). The allow would add a second matching line (A3 would count 2). The tests are therefore written unwrap/expect-free (assert_eq!/assert!, and match with a total Err arm for Cylinder::new/Cone::new) so the allow is unnecessary and A3 stays at 1.
SpanCache derives Debug in addition to the packet's #[derive(Default)] so the crate's missing_debug_implementations warn (denied in release) stays clean.
disagreements: The packet (§1) says BoundingBox / DerivativeBounds / BoundedPiece come from truck_base::bvh. The BG-SOL-P0-BVH scaffold (vendor/truck/truck-base/src/bvh.rs) declares the module and its target API in docs only: neither DerivativeBounds nor BoundedPiece is defined anywhere in the tree (grep across vendor/truck confirms only doc-comment mentions). Since write_allow is only span.rs, DerivativeBounds is defined here (pub struct with first/second BoundingBox<Point3>) and documented so the BVH packet can re-name or re-export it; BoundedPiece remains the BVH packet's to land.

Anchor A3 vs regression-test instruction conflict (see deviations): the packet's own mandated test-module allow attribute and the anchor's expect:1 count cannot both hold; resolved in favor of the anchor (unwrap/expect-free tests).

Pre-existing failure, NOT caused by this packet (verified by stashing span.rs and reproducing on the clean base): vendor/truck/truck-geometry/tests/circle.rs::search_parameter_with_range is a proptest property test over random start in [-100,100], length in [0.01,PI], lerp_ratio in [-0.1,1.1] asserting prop_assert_near2!(search_nearest_parameter(p, range, 1), t). On some random seeds the returned angle differs from t beyond the near tolerance (periodic-branch / large-offset behaviour); once found, proptest persists the case to tests/circle.proptest-regressions and replays it, so the failure then looks deterministic. On a clean tree it passes 5/5 consecutive runs. It passed in the final full run. It is unrelated to the span module.
baseline_failures: circle.rs::search_parameter_with_range (flaky proptest, pre-existing): fails only on unlucky random seeds; reproduces identically with span.rs stashed to the base scaffold, so it is not caused by this packet. See disagreements for the mechanism.
notes: Resolved reading 1 (bbox type): SpanRecord.bbox is truck_base::bounding_box::BoundingBox<Point3> (truck-base's f64 broad-phase box, the same family the BVH packet uses), NOT truck-evidence's certified interval Box3; truck-geometry has no inari, and certified enclosures convert outward at the solver boundary. Resolved reading 2 (cache key): SpanCache.spans takes a caller-owned u64 key (HashMap<u64, Vec<SpanRecord>>); Surface is neither Hash nor Eq, and a structural-hash key could silently return the wrong spans, so the caller guarantees uniqueness per distinct Surface. Span counts observed on the test surface (degree-2x2 BSplineSurface over uniform_knot(2,2)): 4 records (2 u-spans x 2 v-spans) over (0.0,0.5) and (0.5,1.0); Plane -> 1 record over (0,1)x(0,1); Sphere -> 1 record over (0,PI)x(0,2PI); Torus -> 1 record; Cylinder and Cone -> 0 records (unbounded v range). Implementation notes: per-knot-span Bezier decomposition raises interior knots to exact degree multiplicity by exact-equality counting (deviation.rs exact_count pattern), then slices each span's (udeg+1)x(vdeg+1) control sub-grid at k*udeg..(k+1)*udeg+1 (junction-shared control points). Derivative hulls are the global-unit Bezier derivative control-point hulls; rational surfaces refuse (empty) on any non-positive weight and carry unknown derivative hulls; Processor recurses and pushes the affine map through boxes exactly (8-corner transform). The per-span regression grid samples strictly interior points because an exact `contains` check on a sample computed at the shared knot can escape the hull facet by one ulp (original-surface de Boor vs refined control hull), while interior strict-convex-combination samples hold with margin. Verification: cargo fmt --check -p truck-geometry, cargo clippy -p truck-geometry --all-targets --no-deps, cargo test -p truck-geometry --lib --tests --no-fail-fast (54 lib + all integration tests green), cargo check --locked -p truck-geometry --all-targets all pass; kernel gates re-verified against base caa41f4.
